Registered Participants

Registered Participants and Registered Sites

 Heat Trust in numbers (at 31 July 2026)
 Registered Participants (heat suppliers): 31
 Registered Sites (heat networks): 154
 Consumers protected: 96,800 (rounded)

 

This page lists:

  • Our Registered Sites: These are all the heat networks that have been registered with us. As heat networks can vary in their design, build and operation, we require heat suppliers to register each heat network with us individually as a Registered Site.
  • Our Registered Participants: These are all the heat suppliers who have Registered Sites with us. Our Scheme rules only apply to a registered heat supplier (as a Heat Trust Registered Participant) for the specific heat networks that they've registered with us (their Heat Trust Registered Sites). A heat supplier who operates more than one heat network may have registered some of their heat networks with Heat Trust, but not others. The appearance of a company's logo on this page therefore doesn't guarantee that a specific heat network is registered with us - please check the full list and map of heat networks to be sure.

Our Scheme protections can only apply to consumers to whom the entity that's registered the heat network with us has a contractual arrangement to supply as individual end users. On larger district heat networks, contractual arrangements can differ by building and not all consumers may have the same contractual heat supplier. Any consumers covered by our Scheme protections should have been given information about our Scheme by their heat supplier.

Our Registered Participants and Registered Sites are listed alphabetically below, with sites grouped by region and local authority. If a region, council or borough isn't listed this means it currently has no heat networks registered with us.

Our Registered Sites are also shown on our map (see navigation menu), which you can use to zoom in on each site's location and click on the site to see its postcode.   

Only our Registered Sites and Registered Participants have permission to use our Heat Trust trademark. Please contact us if you believe this is being used without permission.
